newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RANDGOLD LISTS FIVE GOLD MINES ON NASDAQ.
newsitem.headline: RANDGOLD LISTS FIVE GOLD MINES ON NASDAQ.

text.p: Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd said on Wednesday it had listed the American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) of five South African gold mines on NASDAQ with effect from October 2.
The mines listed were Blyvooruitzicht Gold Mining Co Ltd, Buffelsfontein Gold Mining Co Ltd , Durban Roodepoort Deep Ltd , Grootvlei Proprietary Mines Ltd and Harmony Gold Mining Co Ltd .
The company said in a statement that these were the first South African companies to list on NASDAQ in 15 years.
Randgold chairman Peter Flack said the listings would further improve the international market visibility of the companies as well as the liquidity of their ADRs.
